name: How long does paver installation typically take for a standard patio or driveway project?

mainEntity.name: How long does paver installation typically take for a standard patio or driveway project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a paver installation project varies depending on factors such as the size and complexity of the area, site preparation requirements, and paver material chosen. A standard patio or driveway project, ranging from 300 to 500 square feet, typically takes our experienced team between 3 to 7 days from start to finish. This includes excavation, base preparation, paver laying, joint filling, and final compaction. Larger or more intricate designs may require additional time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard paver patio or driveway installations typically take 3 to 7 days, depending on size and complexity.
